title: Termix
name: termix
description: SSH terminal and server manager in the browser, with saved hosts, tunnels and a file editor. Source: https://github.com/Termix-SSH/Termix
note: Open http://<your-host>:8080 and create an account, which becomes the admin. Registration stays open after that, so switch it off in the admin settings unless you want other people signing up. Hosts, keys and the database live in the /app/data volume, and its secrets are generated there on first start. Behind a reverse proxy it needs websockets. Docs: docs.termix.site
